decisions.why: Carries the amended FR-005: a CANON label is excluded from NEEDS-RESEARCH, and a class the bundle's research answers is MISLABELED. The contract (.claude/agents/impl-drift.md:45-47) says the same.

decisions.summary: Writers per module group (as run, 14 code groups and one for the procedures), each writing claims: NONE for plumbing, UNRESEARCHED where nothing in the record bears and no GUESS label already stood
decisions.why: The amended spec excepts the GM's rulings from the record-silent-means-UNRESEARCHED rule (US6 scenario 2: 'and no ruling of the GM decides it (that is CANON)'; Assumptions: 'and no ruling of the GM decides (that is CANON), is claimed UNRESEARCHED'). D12's writer rule was not amended: read literally, a decision the GM ruled on, which the research record is silent on, is written UNRESEARCHED - the exact passage-shape the amendment's own round 1 returned CHANGES REQUIRED on in the spec. Not impossible, not implied, and it defeats the amendment's purpose (claims on the GM's rulings mislabeled for want of a class). Fix: 'UNRESEARCHED where nothing in the record bears, no ruling of the GM decides it (CANON) and no GUESS label already stood'. The group count 'as run' is a record of the run, within.

decisions.summary: A NEEDS-RESEARCH finding's claim is relabeled UNRESEARCHED and re-checked; DRIFTED alone stands, with any CANNOT-TELL the second round returns
decisions.why: Same seam as D12-writers: under the amended FR-005 a NEEDS-RESEARCH finding is a decision the record does not cover whose claim labels it neither guess, unresearched nor canon; where a ruling of the GM decides it, the amended US6 scenario 2 and Assumptions make it CANON, yet D12 relabels every NEEDS-RESEARCH claim UNRESEARCHED. FR-013 asks only that 'an unresearched decision' be labeled UNRESEARCHED. Fix: 'relabeled UNRESEARCHED, or CANON where a ruling of the GM decides it'. The CANNOT-TELL part stands as ruled at round 2.
